SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, state_reference])
-> FILTER(state_reference = 'US')
-> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
-> SEM_EXTRACT("Extract only numeric expected-versus-actual pairs whose two values concern the same quantity and context. Return one document annotation with valid_comparisons as a list of {measurement_type, expected_value, actual_value, deviation}; normalize measurement_type to {altitude,speed,heading,runway}, summarize deviation in at most six words, and use an empty list when none qualify.", {incident_id:string, valid_comparisons:list[{measurement_type:string, expected_value:string, actual_value:string, deviation:string}]}, {incident_id,text})
-> FILTER(CARDINALITY(valid_comparisons) > 0)
-> GROUP_BY([measurement_type], {comparison_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id,expected_value,actual_value), most_common_deviation:MODE(deviation)})

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep agreements containing an operative non-compete clause and at least one operative customer or employee non-solicitation clause', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep mutual NDAs, unilateral NDAs, and confidentiality-and-standstill agreements', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Return the non-compete duration and the presence and duration of each customer and employee non-solicitation restriction; if evaluated before the scope filter, return not_in_scope for other documents', out_schema={noncompete_duration_years: float|null, customers_present: boolean, customers_duration_years: float|null, employees_present: boolean, employees_duration_years: float|null}, input_bindings={document: text})
-> PROJECT(CASE WHEN noncompete_duration_years IS NULL OR (customers_present AND customers_duration_years IS NULL) OR (employees_present AND employees_duration_years IS NULL) THEN 'Partially Unspecified' WHEN noncompete_duration_years > MAX_PRESENT(customers_duration_years, employees_duration_years) THEN 'NC Longer' WHEN noncompete_duration_years < MAX_PRESENT(customers_duration_years, employees_duration_years) THEN 'NS Longer' ELSE 'Equal' END AS duration_pattern)
-> GROUP_BY(keys=[duration_pattern], aggs=[COUNT(*) AS document_count])

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep agreements that also contain injunctive relief, an IP-ownership clause, and a survival clause', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep mutual NDAs, unilateral NDAs, and confidentiality-and-standstill agreements that contain all six operative confidentiality exceptions', input_bindings={document: text})
-> PROJECT(document_id, WORD_COUNT(document_text) AS word_count)
-> ORDER_BY(keys=[word_count ASC, document_id ASC])
-> LIMIT(15)

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep policies that go beyond baseline SEC requirements and identify a company', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep clawback or compensation-recovery policies', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Return document ID, primary stated company, latest identifiable policy version date, trigger pattern as restatement_only or restatement_and_misconduct, and whether covered persons extend beyond executive officers; if evaluated before the scope filter, return not_in_scope for other documents', out_schema={policy_document_id: string, company: string, policy_version_date: date|null, trigger_pattern: string, coverage_extends_beyond_executive_officers: boolean}, input_bindings={document: text})
-> DEDUP(keys=[NORMALIZE_COMPANY_NAME(company)], keep=LATEST(policy_version_date, policy_document_id ASC))
-> PROJECT(company, trigger_pattern, coverage_extends_beyond_executive_officers)

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
-> FILTER(REGEXP_LIKE(text, '(?i)(^|[^A-Za-z0-9])10\s*b\s*5\s*[-‐‑‒–—−]\s*1([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)'))
-> SEM_FILTER('Is this an insider trading policy that covers family or household members?', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the document name, policy title, whether short sales are prohibited, whether pledging is prohibited, and the stated approval or effective date', {document_name: str, policy_title: str, prohibits_short_sales: bool, prohibits_pledging: bool, policy_date: date|null})
-> FILTER(prohibits_short_sales = TRUE AND prohibits_pledging = TRUE AND policy_date IS NOT NULL AND policy_date < DATE '2024-01-01')
-> ORDER_BY(policy_date ASC, document_name ASC)

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('agreement expressly contains a non-compete clause, an employee or customer non-solicitation clause, injunctive-relief language, and severability language') -> SEM_FILTER('document is an EX-10 material contract exhibit, including dual-labeled exhibits') -> SEM_EXTRACT('non-compete duration; employee non-solicitation duration; customer non-solicitation duration') -> FILTER(non_compete_duration IS NOT NULL AND (employee_non_solicitation_duration IS NOT NULL OR customer_non_solicitation_duration IS NOT NULL)) -> PROJECT(non_compete_months = normalize_to_months(non_compete_duration), longest_non_solicitation_months = MAX(normalize_to_months(employee_duration), normalize_to_months(customer_duration)), comparison_class = CASE WHEN non_compete_months > longest_non_solicitation_months THEN 'non_compete_longer' WHEN non_compete_months = longest_non_solicitation_months THEN 'equal' ELSE 'non_solicitation_longer' END) -> GROUP_BY(comparison_class, agreement_count = COUNT(*), average_non_compete_months = ROUND(AVG(non_compete_months), 2), average_longest_non_solicitation_months = ROUND(AVG(longest_non_solicitation_months), 2))

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) AS nda_docs
-> SEM_FILTER('document is a mutual NDA, unilateral NDA, or confidentiality-and-standstill agreement with a finite stated confidentiality term')
-> SEM_EXTRACT('nda_document_id, stated corporate party names, and confidentiality duration normalized to years', {nda_document_id: string, nda_company_parties: list[string], nda_duration_years: float}) AS nda_records
SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) AS restrictive_docs
-> SEM_FILTER('the agreement contains an operative non-compete clause with a finite stated duration')
-> SEM_FILTER('document is an employment agreement or standalone restrictive-covenant agreement')
-> SEM_EXTRACT('restrictive_document_id, stated corporate party names, and non-compete duration normalized to years', {restrictive_document_id: string, restrictive_company_parties: list[string], noncompete_duration_years: float}) AS restrictive_records
JOIN(nda_records, restrictive_records, on=INTERSECT(NORMALIZE_COMPANY_NAMES(nda_company_parties, casefold=true, remove_punctuation=true, remove_legal_suffix=true), NORMALIZE_COMPANY_NAMES(restrictive_company_parties, casefold=true, remove_punctuation=true, remove_legal_suffix=true)) IS NOT EMPTY AND nda_document_id != restrictive_document_id)
-> PROJECT(company_name := LEXICOGRAPHICALLY_SMALLEST_MATCHED_STATED_VARIANT, nda_document_id, restrictive_document_id, nda_duration_years, noncompete_duration_years)

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
-> FILTER(word_count > 5000)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep policies that discuss Rule 10b5-1 plans and expressly cover family or household members', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep policies that state no policy approval or adoption date', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep substantive insider-trading policies', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Return document ID and all stated company names, excluding individual officer names', out_schema={document_id: string, company_names: 'list[string]'}, input_bindings={document: text})

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep policies that go beyond baseline SEC clawback requirements and include misconduct as a recovery trigger', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep genuine EX-97 clawback or compensation-recovery policies', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep policies that explicitly extend recovery beyond executive officers to non-executive employees, directors, or key managers', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Return the primary stated company name', out_schema={company: string}, input_bindings={document: text})
-> DEDUP(keys=[NORMALIZE_COMPANY_NAME(company)])

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep mutual NDAs, unilateral NDAs, and confidentiality-and-standstill agreements', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep agreements whose confidentiality obligation is expressly perpetual or indefinite', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep agreements with no severability clause', input_bindings={document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep agreements with no operative exception for independently developed information', input_bindings={document: text})
-> PROJECT(document_id)

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('Does the agreement include all six exceptions: public information, prior knowledge, independent development, third-party receipt, legal compulsion, and consent?') -> SEM_FILTER('Is this a standalone NDA, not an NDA|EX-10 agreement?') -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the finite confidentiality term in years and stated governing law; return null when either is absent or the term is perpetual', {term_years: float|null, governing_law: str|null}) -> FILTER(term_years IS NOT NULL AND governing_law IS NOT NULL) -> GROUP_BY(governing_law, agreement_count = COUNT(*), term_lengths_years = SORT_ASC(DISTINCT(ROUND(term_years, 4)))) -> FILTER(agreement_count >= 3) -> ORDER_BY(agreement_count DESC, governing_law ASC)

SOX := SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
  -> SEM_FILTER('Is this a SOX Section 302 certification document?')
  -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the certified company entity and certifying officer with title', {company: str, certifying_officer: str})
  -> GROUP_BY(company, certifying_officers=SORT_ASC(DISTINCT(certifying_officer)));
CLAWBACK := SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
  -> SEM_FILTER('Is this a clawback or compensation-recovery policy?')
  -> SEM_FILTER('Does the policy permit recovery for misconduct?')
  -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company entity and normalize the covered-person category', {company: str, covered_person_category: str})
  -> DEDUP(company, covered_person_category);
SUBSIDIARIES := SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
  -> SEM_FILTER('Is this a subsidiary-list filing?')
  -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the parent company entity and number of listed subsidiaries', {company: str, subsidiary_count: integer})
  -> FILTER(subsidiary_count >= 70)
  -> GROUP_BY(company, largest_subsidiary_count=MAX(subsidiary_count));
CLAWBACK_SUBSIDIARIES := SEM_JOIN(left=CLAWBACK, right=SUBSIDIARIES, instruction='match the same company entity despite naming, punctuation, or corporate-suffix variation');
ALL_THREE := SEM_JOIN(left=CLAWBACK_SUBSIDIARIES, right=SOX, instruction='match each company in the completed clawback-subsidiary relation to its SOX certification entity');
ALL_THREE
  -> ORDER_BY(largest_subsidiary_count DESC, company ASC)

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('Is this document classified as an NDA, including a dual-labelled NDA exhibit, with an effective date strictly after 2010-01-01?') -> SEM_FILTER('Do confidentiality or non-use obligations expressly survive termination or expiry or continue beyond the stated term?') -> SEM_FILTER('Does the agreement require destruction of at least some confidential materials or copies, excluding clauses that only require return or merely allow an unrestricted choice between return and destruction?') -> SEM_FILTER('Does the confidential-information definition explicitly include electronic data or records, email, software or code, metadata, or other computer-readable material?') -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract and canonicalize the expressly stated governing-law jurisdiction; return null when unstated', {governing_law: str|null}) -> FILTER(governing_law IS NOT NULL) -> GROUP_BY(governing_law, matching_count = COUNT(*)) -> ORDER_BY(matching_count DESC, governing_law ASC)

SOX = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('Is this an EX-31 SOX officer certification?') -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the certified company entity and certifying officer name with title', {company: str, certifying_officer: str}) -> GROUP_BY(company, certifying_officers = SORT_ASC(DISTINCT(certifying_officer))); CLAWBACK = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('Does the policy provide financial-restatement recovery and also permit recovery for misconduct?') -> SEM_FILTER('Is this an EX-97 clawback policy?') -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company entity and normalize the policy covered-person category', {company: str, covered_person_category: str}) -> DEDUP(company, covered_person_category); SEM_JOIN(SOX, CLAWBACK, on='same company entity despite naming, punctuation, or corporate-suffix variation') -> PROJECT(company, certifying_officers, covered_person_category)

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('agreement expressly contains both a standstill provision and an employee non-solicitation clause') -> SEM_FILTER('document is a non-disclosure agreement, including dual-labeled NDA exhibits') -> SEM_EXTRACT('standstill duration; employee non-solicitation duration; presence of each of the 6 named confidentiality exceptions') -> FILTER(standstill_duration IS NOT NULL AND employee_non_solicitation_duration IS NOT NULL) -> PROJECT(class_label = CASE WHEN employee_duration > standstill_duration THEN 'employee_restriction_longer' WHEN employee_duration = standstill_duration THEN 'equal' ELSE 'standstill_longer' END, exception_count = sum(six_exception_flags)) -> GROUP_BY(class_label, agreement_count = COUNT(*), average_exception_count = ROUND(AVG(exception_count), 2)) -> ORDER_BY(agreement_count DESC, class_label ASC)

left = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('EX-21 subsidiary-list filing that explicitly identifies its parent company') -> SEM_EXTRACT('parent company; listed subsidiary entity names; subsidiary count'); right = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('the agreement contains a non-compete clause and an employee or customer non-solicitation clause, with both restrictive durations stated') -> SEM_FILTER('EX-10 employment, offer, or separation agreement') -> SEM_EXTRACT('document ID; employer and company entity names'); left -> SEM_JOIN('an EX-10 employer or company entity is the EX-21 parent or an entity explicitly named in that EX-21 subsidiary list', right) -> GROUP_BY(parent_company, subsidiary_count = MAX(subsidiary_count), qualifying_agreement_count = COUNT(DISTINCT document_id))

SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('agreement explicitly defines confidential information and contains both a return-or-destroy obligation and injunctive-relief language') -> SEM_FILTER('document is a non-disclosure agreement, including dual-labeled NDA exhibits') -> SEM_EXTRACT('normalized governing-law jurisdiction; NDA direction as mutual or unilateral; stated finite agreement term in years, with perpetual or unspecified terms as NULL') -> FILTER(governing_law IS NOT NULL AND nda_direction IN {'mutual', 'unilateral'}) -> GROUP_BY(governing_law, mutual_count = COUNT_IF(nda_direction = 'mutual'), unilateral_count = COUNT_IF(nda_direction = 'unilateral'), average_finite_term_years = ROUND(AVG(finite_term_years) IGNORE NULLS, 2)) -> ORDER_BY((mutual_count + unilateral_count) DESC, governing_law ASC) -> LIMIT(3)

RESTRICTIVE_NDAS = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document states a finite non-compete duration and contains a customer or employee non-solicitation clause') -> SEM_FILTER('document has NDA status') -> SEM_EXTRACT('NDA document ID, canonical key for each stated corporate party, and non-compete duration normalized to years', {nda_document_id: string, company_key: string, non_compete_duration_years: float}) -> PROJECT(nda_document_id, company_key, highly_restrictive = non_compete_duration_years > 3); POLICIES = SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all) -> SEM_FILTER('document is an EX-19 insider trading policy') -> SEM_EXTRACT('canonical policy-company key and whether the policy includes a blackout period, pre-clearance, and a Rule 10b5-1 provision', {company_key: string, has_blackout: boolean, has_preclearance: boolean, has_10b5_1: boolean}) -> PROJECT(company_key, comprehensive_policy = has_blackout AND has_preclearance AND has_10b5_1) -> DEDUP([company_key, comprehensive_policy]); JOIN(RESTRICTIVE_NDAS, POLICIES, RESTRICTIVE_NDAS.company_key = POLICIES.company_key) -> GROUP_BY([highly_restrictive, comprehensive_policy], matched_nda_company_pair_count = COUNT(DISTINCT [nda_document_id, company_key]), distinct_company_count = COUNT(DISTINCT company_key))

SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, investigation_reports, selector='*.txt', columns=[file_id,body])
-> FILTER(REGEXP_LIKE(body, '(?is)\[?Tesla\]?.{0,80}?\bModel\s+(3|S|X|Y)\b'))
-> PROJECT([file_id,body,cited_recall_numbers=NORMALIZE(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(body,'(?i)(?<![A-Z0-9])[0-9]{2}\s*[VE][-\s]?[0-9]{3}(?:[0-9]{3})?(?![A-Z0-9])'))])
-> FILTER(LENGTH(cited_recall_numbers)>=1)
-> PROJECT([file_id,cited_recall_numbers])

SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [state_of_incident, medical_attention_flag, summary_text])
-> FILTER(medical_attention_flag='true' AND state_of_incident IN US_50_STATE_CODES)
-> SEM_FILTER('summary_text describes an airbag deployment failure, unintended deployment, inflator rupture, or similar deployment hazard.', input_bindings={text: summary_text})
-> SEM_FILTER('summary_text is airbag-related, including airbags, inflators, pretensioners, or supplemental restraint system behavior.', input_bindings={text: summary_text})
-> GROUP_BY([state_of_incident AS state], aggs={complaint_count: count(*)})
-> ORDER_BY([complaint_count DESC, state ASC])
-> LIMIT(5)

SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [make, component_id, summary_text]) -> FILTER(make='TOYOTA' AND component_id='AIRBAG') -> SEM_FILTER('summary_text reports an occupant injury or burn caused by the airbag deployment', input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> SEM_FILTER('summary_text describes an unintended airbag deployment (airbag deployed without a corresponding collision or impact)', input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> SEM_CLASSIFY('Group each unintended-deployment complaint by likely root cause.', target_labels=['sensor_misfire','software_logic_error','inflator_defect','other'], input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> GROUP_BY([group], aggs={count: count(*)}) -> PROJECT(format_as_dictionary, derive dominant_label = argmax_with_tiebreak(count, tiebreak='alpha_asc'), per_label_counts={group: {count}}, per_label_percentages = {group: round(100.0 * count / sum(count), 1) for each group})

SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints, [make, component_id, injury_count, summary_text]) -> FILTER(make='HONDA' AND component_id IN ['ADAS','BRAKES']) -> SEM_FILTER('summary_text indicates the problem manifested while the vehicle was being driven (not while parked or stationary)', input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> SEM_FILTER('summary_text describes a tangible safety event, NOT a minor inconvenience like screen flicker or infotainment lag or cosmetic blemish.', input_bindings={text: summary_text}) -> GROUP_BY([component_id], aggs={avg_injury: avg(injury_count)}) -> PROJECT(label = case(avg_injury_ADAS - avg_injury_BRAKES > 0.01 -> 'ADAS_higher'; avg_injury_BRAKES - avg_injury_ADAS > 0.01 -> 'BRAKES_higher'; else 'tie'))

SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, investigation_reports, selector='*.txt', columns=[file_id, body]) -> PROJECT([file_id, body, cited_recall_cores=NORMALIZE(REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(body,'(?i)(?<![A-Z0-9])[0-9]{2}\s*[VE][-\s]?[0-9]{3}(?:[0-9]{3})?(?![A-Z0-9])'), format='canonical_core', deduplicate=TRUE)]) -> GROUP_BY([], aggs={investigation_cited_cores: collect_distinct(cited_recall_cores)}) -> JOIN(cross, right=( SCAN_DOCS(NHTSA, recalls, [campaign.number, vehicle.make, component.component_id AS component_id, risk.defect_summary AS defect_summary]) -> FILTER(vehicle.make='FORD') -> DEDUP([campaign.number]) -> SEM_JOIN('Within the same component_id block, match a Ford recall campaign to a Ford complaint only when the complaint narrative describes the same underlying defect as the recall defect summary.', input_bindings_left={component_id: component_id, defect_summary: defect_summary}, input_bindings_right={component_id: c.component_id, complaint_summary: c.summary_text}, right=( SCAN_TABLE(NHTSA, complaints AS c, [complaint_id, make, component_id, summary_text]) -> FILTER(make='FORD') )) -> GROUP_BY([campaign.number], aggs={component_id: any(component_id), corroborating_complaint_count: count_distinct(complaint_id)}) )) -> PROJECT([campaign_number: campaign.number, component_id, corroborating_complaint_count, cited_by_investigation: (core(campaign.number) IN investigation_cited_cores ? 'true' : 'false')]) -> ORDER_BY([corroborating_complaint_count DESC, campaign_number ASC]) -> LIMIT(5) -> PROJECT([rank: row_number(), campaign_number, component_id, corroborating_complaint_count, cited_by_investigation])

-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that do not disclose foreign-currency or exchange-rate risk', {filing_text: document_text})
